\caption{\bt{\system\ architecture: a definition learned once by the built-in analysis optimizer, an LLM agent (here $m_1^3$), is shared by every user agent. Learning path (1--3): the answer provenance of the optimizer's judged tasks becomes a candidate, published after admission checks G1--G7. Use path (4--7): a lookup compares versions and returns the valid revision $m^r$; maintenance reuses check results, runs only missing checks, and repairs a failed definition only with a unique filter that passes regression (G8). Execution path (8--9): a query declaring $m^r$ is checked against its conditions and run on one snapshot. Here only $T_2$ was written, so $c_3$ lacks a current result and $m_2^1$ is pending.}{\system\ 架构：内置分析优化器（大模型智能体）只学一次的定义（此处为 $m_1^3$）由所有用户端智能体共享。学习路径（1--3）：分析优化器判题成功任务的答案溯源成为候选，通过准入检查 G1--G7 后发布。使用路径（4--7）：查找比较版本并返回有效修订 $m^r$；维护复用检查结果，只执行缺失的检查，并只用通过回归测试（G8）的唯一过滤修复失效定义。执行路径（8--9）：声明 $m^r$ 的查询在同一快照上核对其条件并执行。示例中只有 $T_2$ 被写入，因此 $c_3$ 缺少当前版本的结果，$m_2^1$ 处于待验证状态。}}
\label{fig:architecture}
\Description{On the top left, inside MAVRA's area, sit the built-in analysis optimizer, an LLM agent drawn like the user agents but in MAVRA's blue with an LLM mark, and an LLM extractor. User agents, drawn as people asking questions, stay outside MAVRA on the top right; each holds the same shared definition $m_1^3$, which the store marks as learned. In the MAVRA middleware, admission with admission checks G1--G7 on the left publishes into a central shared store of definitions and check results; condition maintenance and bounded repair with regression test G8 sit below the store and write back into it; lookup and same-snapshot validation on the right read from the store, and the revision returned by the lookup is the one the query declares. A version tracker feeds table versions $V(T)$ to the lookup. A SQL database at the bottom holds tables, whose rows changed by ETL writers raise their versions, the versions themselves, and the snapshot $D_s$ on which same-snapshot validation checks every condition of $m^r$ and runs the query. Step numbers 1--9 and arrows are colored by learning, use, and execution path; thick arrows write the shared store and dashed arrows read database state.}
